sentences.text: The learned counsel Smt.S.S. Sailakshmi appearing for the 7 th respondent, in pursuant to our last order, has received instructions to the effect that Abbas (respondent No.7) has stopped the functioning of the 'thattukada' operating in the name of 'Irani Fast Food'.
It is also her submission that the 7th respondent has applied for a licence to the Thiruvananthapuram Corporation but the same is yet to be considered.

According to the learned counsel, the 7th respondent is having a licence under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and the observation to the contrary in the judgment as well as in this Court's order on 9.10.2018, is factually incorrect to this extent.
2.

In view of the above projection made by the 7 th respondent, the learned counsel for the Thiruvananthapuram Corporation submits that the application for licence would be considered in accordance with law and since the ' thattukada' was operating just opposite the appellant's residence, the appellant/writ petitioner would also be heard.
P.Rajagopalan Nair vs Thiruvananthapuram Corporation on 11 October, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24936999/
2 3.

We accordingly order for closure of the Writ Appeal but directing the Thiruvananthapuram Corporation to consider and pass appropriate orders on the application, if any, received from the 7 th respondent, after hearing the 7 th respondent as also the appellant/writ petitioner.
Needless to say, the 7 th respondent could commence the functioning of the 'thattukada' only after obtaining the licence from the Corporation.

Sd/-
Hrishikesh Roy, Chief Justice Sd/-
 A.K.Jayasankaran Nambiar,
